title: Independent source review of canonical dot scanner runtime integration
actions: Read-only source/log review and20 tiny hand-directed word/address models. No candidate/R/builder mutation, writing builder execution, Git, CI, upload, toolchain installation or future plan access.

findings.claim: Independent parent97f->4792 reconstruction and4792->97f inverse match exact full bytes. Only minimal raw classifier/codec, exact Nat scan block, closure block, actual dot-loop glue, matching dot/finish cold conditionals and dot proof are introduced. Existing normal path, scalar operations, sum, addresses/layout/order and later proof text are preserved.

Scanner tests the actual n original A-row/B-column reads at baseA+k and baseB+k*p with posZero getD default. whole=true gives both raw classifiers=false for every Fin n, then whole_model_nonNaN maps each through rawNaN_eq in the correct equality direction. It permits Inf and does not assert products/intermediate acc are nonNaN.
findings.conditions: Original raw words on precisely the actual read range, not all storage globally and not merely the endpoint classifier.
findings.boundaries: Nat arithmetic has no USize truncation; n=0/k>=n is vacuous. Short-circuit A failure avoids B read. Missing array words are actual positive-zero defaults.

findings.claim: The actual-loop theorem quantifies arbitrary acc:Float32 and k, but the raw fold seed is exactly ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 acc. Only original A/B nonNaN inputs are roundtripped. R7W12.ofFloat32_add/mul have no nonNaN premise and handle an already-NaN accumulator or product. The exported bridge specializes the seed to actual+0.
findings.excluded_generalization: Arbitrary metadata-bearing raw seeds are not covered. With n=0, raw seed0xffc01234 stays0xffc01234 while native import is0x7fc00000. Nonempty raw qNaN/sNaN seed counterexamples are also retained.

findings.claim: Both NativeFinal.dot and Packed10.finish retain the old native nonNaN branch. Only a native NaN endpoint triggers whole; true imports the existing native result, false keeps original quiet-stop replay. The two conditional bodies are identical after A/B argument renaming.
findings.not_assumed: A NaN endpoint alone does not imply canonical raw output. The scan premise is separately required on the new accept branch.

findings.claim: dot_eq uses the original normal proof, new all-read-nonNaN theorem on hscan, and original replay proof otherwise. Packed10.finish_eq_dot is byte-identical to parent and still requires result=the exact NativeFinal.dotLoop from+0. With both finishing expressions matching, its rw[hs];rfl route and downstream lane/address/BMM refinements have the same interfaces.
findings.limitation: No claim for arbitrary disconnected result supplied to finish; full old/new expression elaboration remains unrun.

findings.claim: 4792 differs from frozen703 by exactly34 bytes restoring open FloatLib.Floats Competition immediately after reopening Submission. Namespace stack and active parent opens at NativeFinal match parent97f. Global DWordNaN/DDotNonNaNScan and nested Submission.R7W05/R7W12/NativeFinal are unique and ordered before use.
findings.history_boundary: 703 was a preserved static scope omission; no historical Lean compile failure is claimed. Current4792 still needs its own elaboration.

findings.claim: Read actual W12c source snapshots, explicit exit0 records/logs and41 raw axiom reports. The accepted public host is exact60f plus an unused proof increment. Its increment matches the minimal61d closure after comment/whitespace normalization; compiled closure assertions require forall a b:Float32 without nonNaN hypotheses. This supplies real API/proposition evidence, not4792 acceptance.

20 directed cases check original-input/endpoint distinctions, Inf invalid operations, finite overflow then opposite Inf, +/-0, n=0, arbitrary native canonical-NaN seed, actual strided reads, out-of-bounds defaults and three false raw-seed generalizations. Independent masked-word classification and suffix interval checks agree. Fourteen actual+0 exported-dot cases match full raw-fold model outputs;16 whole=true cases match the actual seed-restricted bridge.
findings.model_source: Existing fixed word oracle AST functions; canonical-native model, not actual Lean/hardware.
findings.scope: Standalone scanner traces are labeled as if called; normal source endpoints execute zero scans.

minimal_required_signatures.whole_model_nonNaN: ∀ (n baseA baseB p : Nat) (A B : Array Binary32), DDotNonNaNScan.whole n baseA baseB p A B = true → ∀ k : Fin n, Model.isNaN (Model.NativeBinary32.ofUInt32 (A.getD (baseA+k.val) posZero).raw.1) = false ∧ Model.isNaN (Model.NativeBinary32.ofUInt32 (B.getD (baseB+k.val*p) posZero).raw.1) = false
minimal_required_signatures.raw_nonNaN_native_nonNaN: ∀ q : Binary32, Model.isNaN (Model.NativeBinary32.ofUInt32 q.raw.1) = false → (ExecFloat.Binary.toFloat32 q).isNaN = false
minimal_required_signatures.dotLoop_eq_of_whole_nonNaN: ∀ (n baseA baseB p : Nat) (A B : Array Binary32) (k : Nat) (acc : Float32), DDotNonNaNScan.whole n baseA baseB p A B = true → ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 (NativeFinal.dotLoop n baseA baseB p A B k acc) = Fin.foldl.loop n (fun a i => ExecFloat.add a (ExecFloat.mul (A.getD (baseA+i.val) posZero) (B.getD (baseB+i.val*p) posZero))) (ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 acc) k
minimal_required_signatures.dot_eq_of_whole_nonNaN: ∀ (n baseA baseB p : Nat) (A B : Array Binary32), DDotNonNaNScan.whole n baseA baseB p A B = true → ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 (NativeFinal.dotLoop n baseA baseB p A B 0 (Float32.ofBits 0)) = Fin.foldl n (fun a i => ExecFloat.add a (ExecFloat.mul (A.getD (baseA+i.val) posZero) (B.getD (baseB+i.val*p) posZero))) posZero
minimal_required_signatures.finish_eq_dot_premise: result = NativeFinal.dotLoop n baseA baseB p Araw Braw 0 zero32
